title: Castrol India
extract: Castrol India Limited is an automotive and industrial lubricant manufacturing company. Castrol India is the 2nd largest manufacturer of automotive and industrial lubricants in the Indian lubricant market and owns around 20% market share in the overall Indian lubricant market. It is part of Castrol Limited UK (part of BP Group). It has 5 manufacturing plants that are networked with 400+ distributors, serving over 70,000 retail outlets.
